attributes.board_name: Maryland Board of Professional Counselors and Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 30 Category A (programs by Board-authorized sponsors; automatically approved: AAMFT, ACA, NBCC, other national organizations and affiliates, accredited higher-education institutions, state health departments) and max 10 Category B; home study excluded
rules.new_licensee_rule: Renewal period shorter than 2 years: minimum 20 Category A CEUs.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of a percentage of renewals; keep documentation 4 years.

topics.who: All health occupations licensees: one-time attestation of an implicit bias course and (HB 782) a structural racism course

rules.notes: Same board and CE chapter as counselors. No ethics hour minimum found in COMAR 10.58.05.
rules.rule_quote: The certificate or license holder shall complete a minimum of 40 CEUs in each renewal period, as follows: (1) At least 30 CEUs shall be in Category A activities and not more than 10 CEUs may be in Category B activities; or (2) All 40 CEUs may be in Category A activities.
